acceptanceCriteria.statement: DETERMINISM + NO-RNG STATIC SOURCE: climate-e5.js contains no Math.random()/Date.now() call form; all randomness is alea seeded off macroSeed; writeClimateE5Sphere run twice on the same fresh carrier with the same (regime, macroSeed, drivers) yields byte-identical fields, for every archetype.

verifyVia.input: Static-grep climate-e5.js for /Math\.random\s*\(|Date\.now\s*\(/ (expect zero); run writeClimateE5Sphere(makeSphereField(SHARED_MESH), drivers, {regime, macroSeed:s}) TWICE for s in {1,2,7,42} x regime in {gas-giant, saturnian, neptunian, sub-neptune} and compare the returned Float32Array band/turbulence/mushball fields.
verifyVia.observable: Zero RNG/clock matches; every alea instance is constructed from a macroSeed-derived string; Float32Array equality across the two runs for every (s, regime); a fixed reference (regime:gas-giant, macroSeed:1) matches a checked-in golden byte snapshot.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: BOUNDEDNESS: the signed jet field u(lat), the shear-gated turbulence field, and the mushball compositional field are all finite and within documented analytic bounds for every archetype x seed x driver draw (no NaN/Inf, no runaway amplitude).

verifyVia.input: Over all nodes for every (regime, macroSeed in {1,2,7,42}, drivers spanning the rotation/obliquity/energy ranges), read u(lat), turbulence, mushball fields.
verifyVia.observable: Number.isFinite(v) for every node of every field; |u(lat)| <= the per-regime U bound implied by the amplitude law; turbulence and mushball values within their documented [min,max].

acceptanceCriteria.statement: ZONAL STRUCTURE BAR (signal must PASS): the jet field is a genuine u(lat) — its value is explained by latitude (+ per-body driver scalars), matching an arm's-length re-derivation of the profile from the published Rhines/amplitude coefficients at every node's latitude.

verifyVia.input: On the carrier, per regime, rebuild the u(lat) profile independently from the documented harmonic/Rhines coefficients and drivers; compute the max per-node residual between writer field and the re-derivation.
verifyVia.observable: max |writerField[i] - refProfile(lat[i], drivers)| < 1e-4 for every node of every regime (the field is a true function of latitude, not of position).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: LONGITUDE CONTROL (must FAIL) + NOT-3-REPEATING-BANDS: a longitude-dependent control field provably FAILS the zonality bar (anti-noise falsifier), AND the band field is NOT a fixed 3-band pattern — the Rhines-derived band COUNT varies with the rotation driver.

verifyVia.input: Feed a longitude-perturbed field through the AC3 zonality check; and sample the band count (sign changes of the profile) for a slow-rotator driver vs a fast-rotator driver, same regime/seed.
verifyVia.observable: the longitude-dependent control's residual >> 1e-4 (fails AC3's bar); AND bandCount(fast rotation) > bandCount(slow rotation), strictly monotonic across at least 3 rotation values, landing a Jupiter-plausible ~dozen bands at Jupiter's rotation.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: EQUATORIAL-JET SIGN IS REGIME-CORRECT: the signed equatorial jet is PROGRADE (super-rotating) for Jovian/Saturnian and RETROGRADE for Neptunian/ice-giant, decided by drivers not hard-coded per preset.

verifyVia.input: Read sign(u) at the equator (lat=0) of the writer's signed jet field for regime in {gas-giant, saturnian, neptunian}, driven by their respective driver bundles.
verifyVia.observable: sign(u_equator) > 0 for gas-giant and saturnian; sign(u_equator) < 0 for neptunian; flipping the ice-giant driver toward a Jovian config flips the sign (proves it's driver-organized, not a per-regime constant).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AMPLITUDE LAW FIXES THE NEPTUNE WIND PARADOX: jet speed |U| follows the unified U=f(energy-input/dissipation, shell-depth) law, so the Neptunian config produces the HIGHEST jet amplitude despite the LOWEST energy input — amplitude is not monotonic in insolation.

verifyVia.input: Evaluate peak |U| from the amplitude law for the Jovian, Saturnian, and Neptunian driver bundles (their real energy-input/dissipation and shell-depth scalars).
verifyVia.observable: peak|U|(neptunian) > peak|U|(jovian) even though energyInput(neptunian) < energyInput(jovian); and a naive insolation-only amplitude (control) yields the WRONG ordering (neptunian lowest) — confirming the shell-depth/dissipation term is load-bearing.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: WARD OBLIQUITY INSOLATION + >54deg INVERSION: the annual-mean insolation field W(phi, epsilon) drives band structure, and for obliquity epsilon > 54deg the pole-to-equator insolation gradient INVERTS (hot poles / cold equator) — the Uranus archetype tell.

verifyVia.input: Compute the sign of the annual-mean pole-minus-equator insolation W(pole)-W(equator) for a sweep of obliquity epsilon in {0, 30, 54, 60, 90} degrees; and inspect whether the derived band structure inverts across the threshold.
verifyVia.observable: W(pole)-W(equator) < 0 for epsilon < 54deg and > 0 for epsilon > 54deg (sign flips crossing ~54deg); the high-obliquity band field shows the hot-poles/cold-equator inversion the low-obliquity field does not.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: DEPTH LAYERS ARE PRESENT AS DATA: (i) a filamentary turbulence texture is SHEAR-GATED — its amplitude tracks the local jet shear |du/dphi| and vanishes where shear is zero; (ii) a mushball ammonia compositional banding field is emitted as its own channel.

verifyVia.input: Correlate the turbulence field magnitude against |du/dphi| across latitude; evaluate turbulence at a zero-shear latitude; confirm the mushball field exists and varies in latitude bands independent of albedo.
verifyVia.observable: corr(|turbulence|, |du/dphi|) >= 0.5; turbulence ~ 0 at zero-shear latitudes (gate holds); the mushball field is finite, banded in latitude, and returned as a distinct channel (not folded into u(lat)).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: GAS GIANTS HAVE NO RELIEF: the E5 writer never mutates carrier.height (or any relief channel) for any archetype x seed x driver draw.

verifyVia.input: Snapshot carrier.height before writeClimateE5Sphere and compare after, for every (regime, seed, drivers); static-check the writer body for writes to height/relief channels.
verifyVia.observable: carrier.height byte-identical before/after for every case; no assignment to carrier.height or other relief channels anywhere in the writer.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: BANDS/JETS REACH RENDER FROM THE WRITER: the lab shader consumes the writer's band/jet field instead of computing the harmonic/sin(lat) sum inline — the gas-giant presets render bands sourced from climate-e5, not from the GLSL formula.

verifyVia.input: Open world-engine-lab.html in the browser on the Gas giant (Jovian) preset; inspect that the shader band value is fed from the writer's bandField/bandNorm (uniform/texture) rather than the inline zonalBandCol/jetsDisp harmonic sum; grep the shader for the removed inline sin(lat) band computation.
verifyVia.observable: the rendered gas giant shows bands; the shader reads the writer field (inline harmonic band sum for the band VALUE is removed/replaced by the piped field); toggling the writer output changes the render.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: DISTINCT PER WORLD: Jovian, Saturnian, Neptunian, and hazy sub-Neptune render as visibly different band structures, and two different seeds of the same archetype differ — no single shape recolored.

verifyVia.input: In the lab, render Gas giant (Jovian), Gas giant (Saturnian), Ice giant (Neptunian -> sub-neptune bands), and Sub-Neptune (hazy); then re-roll two macroSeeds of the Jovian preset; screenshot each.
verifyVia.observable: the four archetypes show distinct band counts/contrast/sign; the two Jovian seeds show different band placement/phase; sub-Neptune reads muted (haze mute) vs the crisp Jovian bands, and does NOT come out Jupiter-sized (radius-key collision avoided).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: DRIVER-ORGANIZATION IS VISIBLE: faster rotation renders more bands; the ice-giant equatorial jet reads retrograde; the high-obliquity (Uranus) config renders the hot-poles/cold-equator inversion; the two depth layers (filament texture + mushball banding) read as cohesive-not-noise.

verifyVia.input: In the lab, sweep the rotation driver on a giant and screenshot; render the ice-giant and check equatorial-belt direction cue; render a >54deg-obliquity giant; view a giant close enough to see filament/mushball texture.
verifyVia.observable: band count visibly increases with rotation; ice-giant equatorial belt reads opposite-sign to Jovian; the high-obliquity world shows pole-emphasized (inverted) banding; bands read as churning belts with wispy filaments and ammonia banding, not flat stripes and not static.

verifyVia.observable: Max confirms the giants feel like distinct, physically-caused weather systems with depth/layers — cohesive, varied, neither repetitive-3-band nor noise. Deferred-to-Max; the verify workflow never PASSes this AC.
